The transaction originated from a device marked 'New' for this account (Windows Desktop MatchOS windows x64 dggfwmdd unit-caseCASE-016 | synth-os-case-016 | synth-browser-case-016 | synth-screen-case-016) [EV-1f5a4b36] via an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-eee16325]. The customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4324) [EV-bba8486b], and the same device profile appears in one confirmed fraud case [EV-50a1cb3b]. Six prior closed cases share the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern [EV-2aa377b8]. The customer denies making the purchases and confirms physical card possession [EV-b38ece11].

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report covers CASE-016, a confirmed fraud investigation involving card SC-03016-K953 with two affected transactions (4012180, 4012181) totaling $779.72 in exposure. The initial transaction was flagged by the real-time risk model with a score of 0.81 [EV-72d567ae]. Investigation revealed the transaction originated from a previously unseen device profile (Windows Desktop MatchOS windows x64 dggfwmdd unit-caseCASE-016 | synth-os-case-016 | synth-browser-case-016 | synth-screen-case-016) [EV-1f5a4b36] connecting through an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina [EV-eee16325]. The card exhibited anomalous velocity with two online transactions within 48 hours [EV-672969a5], deviating from the historical average of $253.79 per transaction [EV-361d4c04]. The customer has a prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4324) [EV-bba8486b], and the identical device profile is linked to another confirmed fraud case [EV-50a1cb3b]. Pattern analysis retrieved six prior cases matching the 'card_not_present_new_device' typology [EV-2aa377b8]. The cardholder explicitly denies authorizing the transactions and confirms the physical card remains in their possession [EV-b38ece11]. The convergence of new-device usage, proxy anonymization, prior fraud history, device reuse across cases, and customer denial supports the fraud verdict and warrants SAR filing.
